summary: Build the hotseat game screen: board, hand, status bar, actions, pass-the-device cover, referee panel, log and undo/redo, all by dispatching engine actions through useGame.

next.step: T5 — Game screen: board, actions, referee panel, log, undo (plans/2026-10-25-envi-tcg-sim.md#t5). Read the T5 section and spec §5, §3.2.
acceptance: Given a new game, when players play cards, eat, assign detritivores, decompose, and end turns until someone wins, then every step is doable by clicking with no console errors
Undo restores the prior board; disabled when params.undoEnabled is false
Every RefereeOp is reachable from the referee panel
Disabled controls show checkAction's reason as a tooltip; lastError shows as a toast
Plain CSS with semantic class names (card, card--dead, zone-field, ...) and no styling library; npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run build pass
